_comment: NET-NEW wire shape (C5, C6): GET /api/v1/transfer-targets/agents, the agent-readable agent picker behind the digital and voice transfer dialogs (transfer-dialog.tsx:34, voice-transfer-dialog.tsx:46 read today's AdminOnly GET /admin/agents). Same group, gate and query as fixtures/transfer-target-queues.v1.json (`search` on displayName). Body: PagedResult<TransferTargetAgentDto> with the NEW sealed record TransferTargetAgentDto(string Id, string DisplayName, AgentState State, bool CanAcceptWork), generated as PagedResultOfTransferTargetAgentDto / TransferTargetAgentDto. `id` is the AGENT id (the value POST transfer takes as targetAgentId), never the user id. `state` is the EXISTING AgentState enum serialized PascalCase by UseStringEnumConverter: Offline | Available | Busy | Break | Lunch | Training | ACW | DND (openapi.d.ts:17559) — the Web compares 'Busy', never 'busy' (transfer-dialog.tsx:136 and voice-transfer-dialog.tsx:170 compare lowercase today and never match), and shows a LOCALIZED label for the state, never String(item.state). `canAcceptWork` is AgentStateMachine.IsRoutable(State). Server filters: the caller's own Agent profile is excluded; agents whose user is not Active are excluded in ONE IAgentAccountStatusLookup.WhereUserActiveAsync lookup per request (the same rule as ConversationActor.IsOwnableTargetAsync and ConversationSwitchboard.cs:267, so every listed agent is a transfer target that will not answer target-agent-not-found); Offline agents are LISTED (the switchboard accepts them) and the Web decides how to show them. Ordered by displayName; totalCount counts the agents AFTER the filters. NOT AdminAgentResponseDto (AdminEndpoints.cs:1187: userId, extension, pending reason, capacity are admin data). The Web gets a NEW hook with its own queryKey (never ['agents']: use-agents.ts:97 is shared). `id` is also the `target` of POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/voice-transfer with `kind` `agent` (fixtures/voice-transfer.v1.json): one id for the digital targetAgentId and the voice target. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).

serverRules.source: IAgentStore.ListAllAsync (keyset pages of 1000, Verbara.Platform.Queues/IAgentStore.cs + AgentAccountStatusLookupExtensions.ListAllAsync), then exclude self, search, WhereUserActiveAsync (one lookup), order, page
serverRules.excludesCaller: the caller's own Agent profile (ConversationActor.ResolveAsync(...).Agent), when it has one

webRules.stateLabel: localized through the agent namespace, never String(item.state)
webRules.hook: new file, own queryKey, imports @/core/api/generated (generated-types-adoption gate)
